title: 第3章 趣闻第4章 起程
slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: 一座不起眼的小酒馆开在中城区的集市角落，厚重的石墙上布满青苔，有些腐烂的木牌上刻着几个字体扭曲的大陆通用语“星坠酒窖”
修斯推开镶着铜钉的橡木门，潮湿的麦酒香气裹挟着魔石灯昏黄的光晕扑面而来。
酒馆中央的石砌壁炉里，噼啪作响的火焰舔舐着木材，青绿色的火苗偶尔跃出，在粗粝的石壁上映出点点的焦痕。
墙壁上交错悬挂着褪色的兽头标本，狼人獠牙间还卡着折断的符文箭矢，旁边褪色的战旗在风里轻轻晃动。
弧形吧台由整块乌木打造，表面深深浅浅的刻痕里嵌着精灵符文，据说这些纹路能让酒水始终保持冰爽。
一个戴着独眼眼罩的矮人酒保正擦拭着酒杯。
背后的木架上，装着妖精蜂蜜酒的水晶瓶泛着诡异的暗金色，由晶穗麦酿成麦酒装在橡木桶里渗出深色酒渍。
角落里，几位裹着斗篷的半兽人围坐在雕花圆桌旁，他们的符文长剑与法杖随意倚在桌边。
桌上的青铜烛台淌着蜡泪。
昏暗中，能看到一位森精灵用匕首削着不知道什么魔兽制成的熏肉，油星溅在面前羊皮地图上，在标注着血红符号的地方晕开。
几位窈窕的人类侍女端着颜色各异的酒水和食物在几张木桌之间来回穿梭。
客人们大声交谈着最近的趣闻，声音十分吵闹，各种种族的语言在一楼交汇。
虽然巫师之间普及大陆通用语，但在同族之间还是偏向用其种族的语言交流。
“给我一杯血棘之吻，老托林”
随手丢了几个金币，便上了二楼，巫师的一些日常用度也是用铜，银，金币来支付。
在成为正式巫师之前也是需要摄入食物的，哪怕是一级巫师，也只是能保持几个月不吃东西，只有成为二级巫师才算脱离正常物种，彻底超凡。
有些经过超凡改造的巫师甚至需要食用一些矿物，植物。
三种货币的兑换比例是100：10：1，不过巫师一般是用金币，100枚金币可以兑换1个魔石。
不过一般都不会换，像科瑞拉这样的官方银行倒是规定120枚金币可以换1个魔石，但仅限科瑞拉城内的正式居民。
在二楼的角落找好座，一杯血红色冒泡的酒水便被侍女端了上来，品味着血棘之吻扎嘴的口感，修斯一边小口品尝着美酒一边听着客人大声分享的趣闻。
“那群血虫有点不安分啊，听说血石又被偷了”
“蛮石在上！
，当初就应该彻底抹除他们！”
“海族商队的明天就到咱们港口了”
“听说灵枢工坊的伊莫斯成为极限学徒了！”
有个消息倒引起了修斯的注意。
“半年前才听说刚成为三等学徒吧，五等资质就是不一样。”
极限学徒也称巫师预备役，是指不出意外的情况下有百分之百的概率晋升正式巫师的学徒。
content_en:
An inconspicuous tavern opened in the corner of the market in the middle city. The thick stone walls were covered with moss, and some rotten wooden signs were engraved with several twisted Chinese lingua franca "Xingzhuan Wine Cellar"
Hughes pushed open the oak door inlaid with copper nails, and the damp aroma of ale and the dim yellow glow of the magic stone lamp hit his face.
In the stone fireplace in the center of the tavern, crackling flames licked the wood, and green flames occasionally jumped out, showing scorch marks on the rough stone walls.
Faded animal head specimens are hung staggered on the walls, broken rune arrows are still stuck between the werewolf's fangs, and the faded battle flag next to it is gently swaying in the wind.
The curved bar is made of a single piece of ebony, with elven runes embedded in the deep and shallow scratches on the surface. It is said that these lines can keep the drinks cold.
A dwarf bartender wearing a one-eyed patch was wiping wine glasses.
On the wooden shelf behind, the crystal bottle containing the elf mead glows with a strange dark gold color. The ale made from crystal ear wheat is stored in the oak barrel, with dark wine stains oozing out.
In the corner, several orcs wrapped in cloaks sat around a carved round table, their rune swords and staffs leaning casually on the edge of the table.
The bronze candlestick on the table shed tears of wax.
In the dimness, a forest elf could be seen using a dagger to peel bacon made from an unknown monster. Oil stars splashed on the sheepskin map in front of him, spreading out in places marked with blood-red symbols.
Several slim human maids shuttled back and forth between several wooden tables carrying drinks and food of different colors.
The guests chatted loudly about the latest anecdotes in a very noisy manner, with various ethnic languages ​​mingling on the ground floor.
Although the common language of the mainland is popular among wizards, people of the same race still prefer to communicate in the language of their own race.
"Give me a kiss of bloodthorn, old Thorin."
I threw a few gold coins and went up to the second floor. Some of the wizard's daily expenses were paid with copper, silver, and gold coins.
Before becoming an official wizard, you need to take in food. Even a first-level wizard can only go without eating for a few months. Only when you become a second-level wizard can you be considered to be out of the normal species and completely extraordinary.
Some supernaturally transformed wizards even need to eat some minerals and plants.
The exchange ratio of the three currencies is 100:10:1, but wizards generally use gold coins. 100 gold coins can be exchanged for 1 magic stone.
However, it is generally not exchanged. Official banks like Corella stipulate that 120 gold coins can be exchanged for 1 magic stone, but only for official residents of Corella City.
After finding a seat in the corner of the second floor, a glass of blood-red bubbling wine was brought up by the maid. Savoring the mouth-piercing taste of the Blood Thorn Kiss, Hughes sipped the wine while listening to the anecdotes shared loudly by the guests.
"Those bloodworms are a little restless. I heard that the bloodstone was stolen again."
"The wild stone is on top!
, they should have been completely eradicated from the beginning! "
"The Sea Clan caravan will arrive at our port tomorrow."
"I heard that Imus from Lingshu Workshop has become an ultimate apprentice!"
There was a piece of news that caught Hughes's attention.
"I heard that I just became a third-class apprentice half a year ago. The fifth-class qualification is just different."
Extreme apprentices, also known as wizard reserve, refer to apprentices who have a 100% probability of being promoted to official wizards unless something unexpected happens.
